fee_notes: First franchise: $19,950 Initial Franchise Fee + Initial Territory Fee of $30,000 (Tier 3) to $70,000 (Tier 1). Veterans get 15% discount on both fees. No Initial Franchise Fee for subsequent agreements. Additional territory fee equals then-current Initial Territory Fee ($60,000 for Tier 1 if second territory signed simultaneously).
raw_excerpt: you will pay us an Initial Franchise Fee of $19,950 when you sign the franchise agreement... Initial Territory Fee of between $30,000 and $70,000 depending on the Territory tier.
